heroBadge: A simpler way to bring AI into daily life
heroBody: We're building a simpler way to use AI for everyday tasks, from writing a message to learning something new or planning your day. No AI expertise required.
flowLine: Useful AI should be within everyone's reach.
visionTitle: You know what you want to do.
capability1Title: Start with something you want to do.
capability1Body: Our vision starts with everyday needs: write a clearer message, understand a new topic, or organize a busy day.
capability2Body: You shouldn't have to understand how AI works to use it. We're designing simple steps that help you get started with confidence.
capability3Body: We're focused on everyday outcomes: clearer writing, easier learning, and more organized days, with experiences designed for people at any skill level.
platformBody: We're building a simpler way to use AI for writing, learning, and everyday tasks. Loom AI will bring practical tools, ready-to-use templates, skills, and plugins into guided experiences, so you can focus on what you want to do without learning how AI works.
pricingAccent: Give your ideas room to grow.
pricingBody: From free exploration to an actionable work plan, find a starting point that fits your way of working.
exploreBenefit2: Sign in with Google or GitHub
exploreBenefit3: Discover our vision for everyday AI
proBody: Give your creative idea a clear path forward.
proBenefit2: Keep access across Loom products with one account
proBenefit3: One-time purchase, no subscription or renewal
useCasesLabel: Loom AI's vision for writing, learning, and everyday life
workTitle: A single idea. A new connection.
workBody: Find a clear path from a creative-tool concept to your first release.
ideaTitle: Weave your idea into a next step.
ideaBody: Plan your next step around the goal, the context, and a first release.
planDescription: Take a creative-tool idea from an early concept to a first release.

step1: Define the problem: identify the audience, use case, and first core capability.
step2: Connect the context: gather browser discoveries and the prototype in your editor.
step3: Build a first release: validate the core flow, invite feedback, and iterate.
planGuidance: Adapt these steps to your project goals and turn the plan into actions of your own.
